sessions.transcript_text:
Contact Summary: Conducted an initial intake and consultation with Benito Jackson. Explained the two tracks of the Turn90 program (in-person vs. reentry navigation). Client opted for the in-person 8-week program and will be placed on the waitlist (estimated 2-3 weeks). In the interim, client will receive reentry navigation support. Completed intake assessment covering housing, documentation, legal history, employment, and medical needs.

Case Plan & Briefcase Updates: 
- Identification: Client has Birth Certificate, Social Security Card, and State ID (Verified/Green).
- Transportation/License: Driver's License is suspended until November 27th due to a pending DUI. Client needs SR-22 insurance, $100 fee, and a DUI class to reinstate (Flagged/Red).
- Medical: Client was prescribed Remeron in prison but is currently out. Needs a Primary Care Physician (PCP) to get a new prescription (Flagged/Red).
- Legal: Released (Oct 9, 2025); on parole but gets off next month. Pending court date for DUI charge (represented by lawyer). 
- Child Support: Owes approximately $900 in arrears (Flagged/Red).
- Employment/Education: 12th grade (no diploma/GED). Has 17 years of painting experience and a carpentry certificate from prison. Highly interested in forklift certification.

Referrals/Resources Provided: Discussed upcoming job fairs and agreed to text client details for a job fair on November 12th.

Next Steps: Place client on the center's waitlist. Send job fair information via text. Assist client in identifying a local PCP to restart medication. Map out steps for driver's license reinstatement for when suspension lifts on Nov 27th.
